final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.translink AS translink, r.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader r ON r.tradereg = t.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, r.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM s1 WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(avgcnt) AS overall FROM s2 WHERE avgcnt IS NOT NULL) SELECT s2.tradekind, s2.avgcnt, s2.avgcnt - s3.overall AS diff FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.avgcnt > s3.overall
